summary: <cite index="1-3,8-7">Wall Street rebounded Wednesday after the Treasury Department announced it will more than double the size of its debt buybacks, a signal the US wants to lower borrowing costs after yields hit multi-decade highs.</cite> <cite index="1-4">A rally in 30-year bonds drove yields down by nine basis points to 5.19%.</cite> Markets now await the 2 PM release of July FOMC minutes for insight into the Fed's policy path. <cite index="8-10,8-11">President Trump confirmed no ongoing talks with Iran and paused 50% tariffs on Canadian imports shortly before midnight.</cite> In biotech, Moderna shares doubled on successful cancer vaccine trial results, lifting the broader sector. <cite index="4-9">Marvell Technology expanded its Google partnership and granted the tech giant a warrant to buy up to 58.97 million shares at $206.58.</cite> <cite index="47-12,47-13">Bitcoin and ethereum rose after the SEC announced new proposed regulations providing a framework for crypto companies to raise capital.</cite> <cite index="3-14">Investor sentiment had weakened Tuesday as Middle East uncertainty drove bond yields to multiyear highs, raising concerns over inflation and borrowing costs.</cite>

signals.title: Treasury doubles debt buyback program, yields plunge
signals.desc: <cite index="1-3,1-4">Treasury announced plans to more than double buybacks of longer-dated bonds, sending 30-year yields down 9 bps to 5.19% and supporting equity valuations.</cite>

signals.title: SEC proposes crypto-friendly capital raising framework
signals.desc: <cite index="47-12,47-13,47-14">SEC announced new proposed rules providing a framework for crypto companies to raise capital with two registration requirement exemptions for crypto-related investment contracts.</cite>

signals.title: Moderna doubles on cancer vaccine breakthrough
signals.desc: Moderna shares surged 100% after successful cancer vaccine trial results, lifting biotech ETFs and sector sentiment sharply higher.

signals.title: Trump confirms Iran talks stalled, oil surges
signals.desc: <cite index="8-10">President Trump said there are no ongoing talks with Iran and no new discussions scheduled, nearly six months into the war involving the U.S., Israel and Iran.</cite>

signals.title: FOMC minutes ahead as Fed holds at 3.5%-3.75%
signals.desc: <cite index="36-10">The July FOMC Meeting Minutes release at 2 PM could provide additional insight into policymakers' views on inflation, employment, and the future path of monetary policy.</cite>

verdict: Markets stabilize after Treasury buyback announcement eases yield pressure, but FOMC minutes and Middle East tensions remain key risk factors for afternoon volatility.
